organization_note: Trendyol's contact page gives the address of DSM Grup Danışmanlık İletişim ve Satış Ticaret A.Ş., whose copyright its pages carry, in Maslak, Sarıyer, Istanbul, and its about page lists the Trendyol campus in Maslak among its offices.
